_comment: Single source of truth for the visual identity, matched to the Rx Suite family (rxsuite.ameenmarashi.workers.dev): IBM Plex Mono throughout, deep navy on a pale mint field, mint accent with navy text on it. `npm --prefix web run icons` regenerates every icon, splash and launch image from these values, for the PWA and the iOS/Android apps alike. The Flutter launcher-icon and splash config in flutter_app/pubspec.yaml mirrors `splashBackground` and `splashBackgroundDark`.
